theorems.name: Submission.br_la_abs_apply_le_mul_mass
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n) (C : ℝ), 0 < C → (∀ x : Eucl P, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x) ≤ C) → Y.mass ≠ ∞ → |Y ω| ≤ C * Y.mass.toReal
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
